_meta.method: Web search only. No agent fan-out. Every row carries at least one source URL; rows without one were not written.
_meta.field_coverage_warning: Sector, owner, timeline and power are well covered. LAND AREA, SHELL/ENCLOSURE and UTILITY FILINGS are sparse across the whole set — see data/gaps.json. Web search does not reach docket systems; those three fields need a targeted pass against FERC eLibrary, state PUC dockets and NRC ADAMS.

tracks.label: U.S. Government
tracks.blurb: The only track with signed pairings of a named reactor to a named site. Federal buyers are absorbing first-of-a-kind risk on behalf of the whole market.

tracks.label: International
tracks.blurb: Government machinery and industrial partners, treated as one track — see docs/segmentation.md for why they are not split.

tracks.label: U.S. Commercial
tracks.blurb: Where the volume is, but almost entirely at SMR scale rather than microreactor scale. The microreactor-specific commercial evidence is thin and named.
